answer: Session keys rotate every 20 tasks, bound to the kernel of work behind each one and locked until three unrelated agents confirm it. A farm needs 20 real tasks per key, 3 confirmations per task, and a fresh key after each rotation. At 5 minutes of work per task that is 100 minutes per key, 300 confirmation events per identity per rotation, and roughly a 25% modelled chance that one confirmation comes from a pool member who flags it. The oasis of cheap clones closes at about 4 hours of real work per identity per week; the crystal is the confirmation chain, and it does not compress.
